note: Reproducibility check for the manuscript's Supplementary-Note claim that pre-correction ExcNeuron top-9 is dominated by Cdc20 / Ccnb1 / Cenpf on the 10x E18 multiome dataset.

cc_signal_in_input_latents.interpretation: All three FA latents shipped in the input h5ad are already orthogonal to S/G2M scores at the leading components. The pre-integration correction has already been applied upstream, so downstream 'uncorrected' and 'CC-regressed' pipelines both sit on top of already-corrected latents.

reason: The 'uncorrected' input file (adata_multiome_fa.h5ad) already carries per-modality cell-cycle regression from an upstream preprocessing step. As a result no downstream pipeline in the current repository — with or without further latent-space CC regression — reproduces the Cdc20/Ccnb1/Cenpf-dominated top-9 that the Supplementary Note describes.
what_would_be_needed: A truly-uncorrected pipeline must start from raw RNA + raw ATAC (10x E18 multiome), skip per-modality S/G2M regression, build the joint FA latent, then fit drift → instability. The raw ATAC modality is not present in the input h5ad, so this cannot be done from the currently-stored artifacts.
recommendation: Either (a) re-run the full preprocessing without CC regression starting from raw 10x data and confirm the mitotic-dominance claim, then persist that result alongside the current 'cc' pipeline; or (b) rephrase the Supplementary Note to describe what the current pipeline actually demonstrates (both pre-integration-corrected pipelines return non-mitotic developmental top-9 lists that are highly similar in their gene identities).
